title: Leaderboards — implementation
summary: Allow comparison between public models through transparent, category-based rankings with filtering, historical tracking and full score transparency. Tracks all implementation stories for this epic.
acceptance_criteria: Each category lists public models ranked by the relevant deterministic score
Filtering narrows results without changing ranking semantics
Each ranked entry exposes the score and rationale behind its position
Historical ranking snapshots are retained and viewable
notes:
Scope (in): Categories: Best Social Fairness, Best Economic Growth, Best Fiscal Sustainability, Best NHS Outcome, Best Housing Outcome, Best Balanced Model; Ranking logic; Filtering; Historical tracking; Score transparency
Out of scope: Determining scores (EPIC-003); Making models public (EPIC-006); Monte Carlo / benchmarking research views (EPIC-014)
